dedupe_note: These findings are additional evidence for the existing full-catalog audit UUID only. No application task is created here. Existing completed/pending/waiting_human application UUIDs continue to take precedence over research-only classifications.

tools.commission: Up to $50 per activated signup plus 20% of first-year revenue for each qualifying referral
tools.payout_terms: Current official affiliate page routes existing affiliates to PartnerStack; current public page does not state a payout threshold/method, so those values remain unknown.
tools.eligibility: Official page currently states that Notion is not accepting new affiliate partners.
tools.evidence_summary: Notion's current official affiliate page confirms PartnerStack tracking and the historical/current reward model, but explicitly states that new affiliate partners are not being accepted. This is therefore program_closed for new COSHUMA enrollment and must not be queued for application while that notice remains in force.

tools.commission: 30% of every payment for the lifetime of each paying referred subscriber
tools.payout_terms: Paid monthly; current public page does not expose the exact payout threshold or payout method, so those remain unknown.
tools.eligibility: Official page presents open free signup and does not publish a country restriction on the retrieved page.
tools.evidence_summary: ReactIn's current official affiliate page confirms free signup, a unique referral link through Reditus, 30% lifetime recurring commission on referred subscriber payments, and monthly payouts. Cookie duration and payout threshold are not stated on the public page and are left unknown.

tools.commission: 15% of each payment made by referred users for 360 days after their registration
tools.payout_terms: Rewards are held for 14 days after qualifying purchases. Minimum withdrawal is 10 tokens to the participant's own Octo account or 100 tokens to supported USDT/USDC wallets; 1 token equals 1 EUR. Verified withdrawals are paid on the closest 1st or 15th of the month.
tools.eligibility: Participant must create an Octo Browser account and obtain the referral link from Settings → Referrals. Promotion rules prohibit brand-keyword contextual ads, spam, self-referrals, and referrals to users already known to have Octo accounts.
tools.evidence_summary: Octo Browser's official 2026 documentation confirms an active referral program with 15% revenue share for 360 days, an in-product personal referral link, a 14-day review hold, and documented withdrawal thresholds and payout cadence.

tools.commission: 15% recurring commission on every referred-customer payment for the first 12 months
tools.payout_terms: Minimum payout $25; commissions are tracked in Rewardful and payout can be requested once the threshold is reached.
tools.eligibility: Official page says anyone can sign up as an affiliate and a Surfeo customer account is not required.
tools.evidence_summary: Surfeo's current official affiliate page confirms free Rewardful signup, 15% recurring commission for 12 months, a 60-day cookie, no referral cap, real-time stats, and a $25 payout threshold.

tools.commission: Up to 30% recurring commission on referred paid subscriptions; official page describes the beta rate as long-term recurring
tools.payout_terms: Monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer.
tools.eligibility: Official page describes the program as beta/early access with limited spots; no country restriction is stated on the retrieved page.
tools.evidence_summary: HappyScribe's current official affiliate page confirms an active Impact-hosted beta program, up to 30% recurring commission, 60-day cookie attribution, and monthly PayPal/bank-transfer payouts. Because the page says beta access has limited spots, acceptance is not assumed until actually approved.
